name: YMCA Camp Westwood
description_short: A YMCA camp on 87 lakefront acres in Coventry, RI. Campers are grouped by age and spend the day outdoors doing things like lake swimming, high ropes and crafts. Traditional, themed (immersive) and specialty programs are offered.
swim_waterfront_notes: Lakefront camp with lake swimming, canoeing and sailing. The page does not describe swim tests or lifeguard supervision.
